effects: Pulls exactly `assets` MXNB from the signer into the vault (enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints vault shares (bitmxnbp) to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets) at the current share price, after fees accrue. There is no minimum-shares bound.
May forward the deposited MXNB to the vault's liquidity adapter. That moves vault funds, not the signer's.
formats.shown: Deposit 71.443394 MXNB, with bitmxnbp shares going to the onBehalf address; the share amount is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is computed on chain and has no minimum bound in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. There is no minShares parameter. Case 0 mined: 35.089061229351870846 bitmxnbp in, and the screen has no share amount (only 'Share ticker: bitmxnbp').
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. Could add a note that the share amount depends on the current share price.

cases.notes: The screen states MXNB out with the right amount. The share recipient and ticker are right, but the share amount cannot be shown.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns vault shares from `onBehalf`. The amount is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up, with no maximum-shares bound.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, spends the signer's share allowance from `onBehalf` by that share amount.
Sends exactly `assets` MXNB from the vault to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 500 MXNB to the receiver, from the Owner's position; the shares burned are not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the owner are computed on chain, with no maximum bound in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` and exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2 mined: 245.913818489720655383 bitmxnbp out from the signer. The screen shows no share amount or share ticker.
findings.fix: None from calldata. Could add the vault share ticker as a constant field so the signer knows bitmxnbp shares are burned.

cases.notes: The reader got the MXNB received right. They knew vault shares leave but not the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` bitmxnbp from `onBehalf`, spending the signer's share allowance when the signer is not the owner.
Sends previewRedeem(shares) MXNB from the vault to `receiver`. There is no minimum-assets bound.
formats.shown: Redeem 568.38 bitmxnbp shares to the receiver from the Owner; it never says MXNB is received or how much.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names MXNB as the asset received, though deposit and mint show it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`. Case 3 mined: 1157.374204 MXNB in to the signer. The descriptor's redeem fields are only shares/receiver/onBehalf. The underlyingTicker constant is used in mint but not here. The reader said: 'The screen doesn't say which asset or how much.'
findings.fix: Add a field `{"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` and say 'for MXNB' in the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: redeem: 'Redeem {shares} to {receiver}' reads as if the shares go to the receiver.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}". Case 3 screen: 'Redeem 568.382020412210141021 bitmxnbp to 0x71cb...'. In the mined tx the shares are burned and MXNB goes to the receiver.
findings.fix: Use "Redeem {#.shares} for MXNB to {#.receiver}" and label the receiver field 'Send MXNB to'.

findings.title: redeem: the MXNB amount received is computed on chain, with no minimum bound in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. There is no minAssets parameter. Case 3 mined: 1157.374204 MXNB in, and no amount is on screen.

cases.notes: The reader got the shares burned right. They knew something arrives but not that it is MXNB or how much.

effects: Pulls previewMint(shares) MXNB from the signer, rounded up, with no maximum-assets bound.
May forward the deposited MXNB to the liquidity adapter. That moves vault funds, not the signer's.
formats.shown: Mint 1 bitmxnbp to the onBehalf address, paid in MXNB; the MXNB amount is not shown.

findings.title: mint: the MXNB taken from the signer is computed on chain, with no maximum bound in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. There is no maxAssets parameter. Case 1 mined: 1.998999 MXNB out from the signer. The screen shows only 'Deposit asset: MXNB'.
findings.fix: None from calldata. Could relabel to 'Pays in' and add a note that the amount depends on the share price.

cases.notes: The screen names MXNB as the asset paid but not the amount. The shares went to 0xdEaD, which the screen shows plainly and the reader understood.
